definition: Information that does not follow a fixed schema, such as text, documents, images, audio and video.
details: Most enterprise data is unstructured and historically hard for software to query. Embeddings and vector search changed that by turning raw documents into comparable numerical representations, making the data searchable by meaning rather than exact keywords.
story: Imagine a chef tasting every ingredient before it goes into the pot, deciding what belongs and what would ruin the broth. Boil it down and it is this: Information that does not follow a fixed schema, such as text, documents, images, audio and video. Here is why it matters: Most enterprise data is unstructured and historically hard for software to query. It is the raw material; the model is only ever as good as what it was fed. That care with the raw material is Unstructured Data.
